subject.title: [Bug]: Trajectory files fed back as context cause unbounded token consumption and unexpected API billing

question: Is source-level evidence plus v2026.6.11 guard presence enough to close this billing report, or should maintainers require live current-main proof of the Windows fresh-session provider path first?
rationale: The issue has high-impact cross-provider billing evidence, while current code has multiple guardrails but no exact runtime proof for the reported setup.

options.title: Require live proof before close
options.body: Keep the issue open until a current-main Windows or equivalent packaged proof shows large trajectory sidecars do not affect startup/model context for a fresh session.

options.title: Close from source guardrails
options.body: Close as effectively fixed by the current trajectory, reseed, TUI, gateway, and memory filters despite the missing end-to-end billing proof.

options.title: Patch after focused repro
options.body: If the focused proof still shows trajectory-derived context, patch the remaining ingestion path rather than broadening config or adding a new mode.
